A '''repulsor beam projector''' was a device that took the power generated by a [[repulsor beam generator]] to project a [[repulsor beam]]. [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] colonies had repulsor beam projectors installed on the outer surface to project repulsor beams in the creation of a [[repulsorfield shell]] to protect the colonies from colliding with other asteroids.<ref name="SFS" />
